title: New Hampshire Democrats Sound an Alarm: ‘We’re Losing’
summary: The state has not elected a Republican to the Senate since 2010. But Chris Pappas, the likely Democratic nominee, anticipates a tough race against a well-known opponent, John E. Sununu.
